reason: The HIGH/CRITICAL findings in these paths belong to the upstream ORCE 2.0.13 runtime (its bundled Node-RED, palette and npm dependencies) and to kubectl v1.35.10, the newest 1.35 patch release on 2026-11-21, which upstream still builds with golang.org/x/net v0.56.0 and golang.org/x/text v0.39.0 (CVE-2026-78661, CVE-2026-78669, CVE-2026-56851). They cannot be fixed in this project's layer without modifying the mandated upstream component or rebuilding kubectl. Helm, built here from source at v4.3.2 (golang.org/x/net v0.62.0), scans clean and is back under the gate. Everything this project adds stays under the scan gate.
tracking: Client confirmation of the exception and a rebuilt ORCE image from Eclipse XFSC requested through FACIS on 2026-09-23. On 2026-11-21 the Helm entry was removed (v4.3.2 scans clean) and kubectl moved to v1.35.10, which still carries the findings above. Drop /usr/local/bin/kubectl from skipFiles once a newer 1.35 patch release scans clean without it. Remove this file when the pin moves to a rebuilt ORCE and a patched kubectl.
